title: verify.rs: duplicate '# Errors' section in doc comment
description: verify.rs lines 58 and 68 both contain '# Errors' headings in the same doc comment for the verify() function. The first one (line 58) is empty — it has no content before the next heading at line 61. This creates a malformed rustdoc comment with a stray empty section header. The rendered documentation will show an empty 'Errors' section above a second 'Errors' section. Remove or merge the duplicate heading.
